The number of ways to choose 6 cookies from n cookies is given by the combination formula \( \binom{n}{6} \). Here, n is at least 18, but since we are only selecting 6 cookies and there are no restrictions on the types, the number of ways is \( \binom{18}{6} \).

Calculating \( \binom{18}{6} \):
\[

\]
Therefore, the number of different assortments of six cookies that can be selected is \boxed{18564}.
